findings.issue: spec.result_dir is joined directly into results_root, so an absolute path or '..' component can make attempt output escape the intended results tree.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the candidate path and reject it unless it remains under the resolved results_root.

findings.issue: Attempt directory allocation is non-atomic, so concurrent executions for the same result_dir can both select the same attempt number and overwrite or interleave logs.
findings.suggestion: Create each attempt directory with an atomic mkdir that fails on existing paths and retry on FileExistsError.

findings.issue: On Windows a timeout only kills the direct process, leaving child processes launched by cmd or dsh able to keep running after the task is marked failed.
findings.suggestion: Create a Windows process group or job object and terminate the full process tree on timeout.
